description.text:
About Acast
Since 2014, Acast has been building the world’s most valuable podcast marketplace, creating the technology that connects podcast creators, advertisers, and listeners. Its marketplace spans more than 140,000 podcasts, 3,300 advertisers, and one billion quarterly listens. Crucially, those listens are monetized wherever they happen—across any podcast app or listening platform.


About the role
We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our BI team as the trusted data partner for Finance, Product, Sales, and Content Managers who work day-to-day with our podcasters. This role puts you at the forefront of agentic analytics, building the foundation that empowers AI agents to help stakeholders directly query and navigate complex data on their own. Spanning full-stack data work from raw data to consumption-ready dashboards, the position is as much about people and clear context as it is about data, so you'll spend as much time listening, clarifying, and building trust as you will building models.
The best person for this role is someone who genuinely enjoys sitting with a stakeholder's half-formed question, working out what they're really asking, and bringing back an answer that makes their decision easier. You'll care as much about how something lands with the person asking as about whether the number is right.


What you'll do
Be the first person Finance, Product, Sales, and Content Managers turn to when they have a data question they can't quite put into words yet, and help them find the words.
Own and evolve our core reporting infrastructure and data models in dbt and Omni across podcast consumption, listens, views, revenue, payout, and product analytics metrics - structuring underlying business logic so AI agents in Omni can reliably answer stakeholder questions in real time.
Build and maintain dashboards that people actually understand and want to use, not just ones that are technically correct.
Notice patterns and risks in payout, platform, and podcast consumption metrics before they become someone else's problem, and flag them early and clearly.
Support Content Managers and Product teams with the data behind podcast consumption analysis, covering listens and views metrics as well as performance trends and payout questions, and help Sales understand what the numbers mean for their conversations with advertisers.
Support teammates by explaining your thinking, documenting decisions, and making it easy for others to pick up where you left off.
Collaborate closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers, developers, and Product Managers to ensure consistency across data models, metrics, and definitions.



Who you are
Someone who listens well and asks good follow-up questions before jumping to a solution.
Strong SQL and dbt skills, proficiency in BI tools like Omni, and experience accelerating analytics development using AI tools such as Cursor or Claude.
A steady, careful approach to data that people can rely on — especially where finance and payouts are involved.
Comfort holding several relationships at once — Finance, Product, Sales, and Content — without losing warmth or clarity under pressure.
A collaborative, generous way of working: sharing context, mentoring where helpful, and making the people around you better at their jobs too.
Proven ability to translate complex business logic into robust, maintainable data models and clear metrics definitions.



Culture 
Acast is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin or any of the other wonderful characteristics that make us different.
Culture is our number one priority as a business. We believe people come first, and we work every day to enable autonomy, continuous improvement and bring out the best in people. We’re global and have remote teams, so it’s even more important that we strive for an open, inclusive and caring environment where everyone feels visible and welcome. 
We consider ourselves a modern organization driven by strong values to create the best, most fulfilling and nurturing culture.
We very much look forward to finding the next great person to join our cause!

description.text:
Vill du arbeta i
gränslandet mellan data, verksamhet och digitalisering? Är du analytisk,
nyfiken och gillar att lösa problem tillsammans med andra? Då kan detta vara en
perfekt möjlighet att utvecklas hos Husqvarna Group.

Om rollen

Som Junior Traceability
Data Analyst blir du en del av Digital Infrastructure-teamet inom Global Data
Solutions. Teamet ansvarar för den data som gör det möjligt att spåra
Husqvarnas produkter genom hela deras livscykel, från fabrik och leverantör
till slutkund.

Det här är en junior
roll där du får möjlighet att utvecklas långsiktigt. Du kommer att arbeta nära
erfarna kollegor inom traceability och digitalisering samtidigt som du
successivt bygger upp din egen kompetens inom området. Målet är att du på sikt
ska bli en nyckelperson i teamet.

Rollen är bred och
kombinerar dataanalys, problemlösning, koordinering och verksamhetsutveckling.
Du kommer att utreda dataproblem, analysera informationsflöden och samarbeta
med både fabriker, leverantörer och interna funktioner över hela världen. 

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland
annat att:

Hantera och utreda supportärenden
     kopplade till produkt- och serienummerdata.

Analysera datakvalitet och identifiera
     avvikelser, fel och förbättringsområden.

Samarbeta med fabriker och leverantörer
     för att lösa datarelaterade problem.

Följa upp data och säkerställa
     att informationen är korrekt och komplett.

Arbeta i Power BI och Excel för att
     analysera och visualisera data.

Bidra till utvecklingen av nya
     processer, arbetssätt och riktlinjer kring datahantering.

Vi söker dig som

Vi tror att du har ett
stort intresse för data, teknik och verksamhetsutveckling. För att lyckas
behöver du inte vara programmerare, men du behöver förstå hur IT-system och
dataflöden fungerar och tycka om att arbeta analytiskt.

Om rollen

Som Junior Traceability Data Analyst blir du en del av Digital Infrastructure-teamet inom Global Data Solutions. Teamet ansvarar för den data som gör det möjligt att spåra Husqvarnas produkter genom hela deras livscykel, från fabrik och leverantör till slutkund.

Vi tror att du har ett stort intresse för data, teknik och verksamhetsutveckling. För att lyckas behöver du inte vara programmerare, men du behöver förstå hur IT-system och dataflöden fungerar och tycka om att arbeta analytiskt.

description.text:
A Snapshot of Your Day
As our installed fleet continues to grow, the need for data-driven decision making becomes increasingly important. We are therefore expanding our Service R&D team with a Data Analyst for our installed fleet of medium gas turbines. You will help us transform operational data into better decisions. Working closely with engineering, overhaul, parts, and IT teams, you will identify patterns, predict fleet behaviour, and create insights that improve reliability and customer value.
You will join an open and supportive team where knowledge sharing and collaboration are central to how we work. You will work closely with colleagues across both service and new development organizations, connecting operational data with practical engineering and business decisions.
The role will give you an understanding of how operational behaviour, technical design, and lifecycle considerations interact to influence fleet performance and customer value.

How You’ll Make an Impact
Analyze operational and maintenance data from our installed fleet.
Develop models and methods that support maintenance planning and lifecycle management.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities that can improve fleet performance and availability.
Build and maintain data structures and analytical tools that enable efficient decision-making.
Create clear visualizations and reports that turn complex data into actionable insights.
Contribute to the development of future service offerings and digital solutions.

What You Bring
Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, data analytics, data science, applied mathematics, or a related field.
Experience working with large datasets and extracting meaningful business insights.
Strong analytical and skills 
An interest in industrial products, mechanical systems, and how they perform throughout their lifecycle.
The ability to communicate analytical findings in a way that supports business and technical decisions.
A curious and proactive mindset, with a desire to understand both the data and the operational reality behind it.
Fluency in Swedish and English

About the Team
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

description.text:
Vår kund brinner för att hjälpa företagare att lyckas genom innovativa lösningar. Här får du chansen att förvandla digitalt brus till värdefulla insikter och forma framtidens datadrivna landskap i en dynamisk miljö.
Om tjänsten
I rollen som Analytics Engineer hamnar du i navet mellan teknik och affär. Du ansvarar för att städa upp i det digitala bruset och bygga de broar som krävs för att förvandla rådata till insikter som verkligen räknas.
Du erbjuds
Möjlighet att forma det datadrivna landskapet: Du får en nyckelroll i navet mellan teknik och affär där du bygger datamodeller och pipelines (med verktyg som dbt) som förvandlar rådata till konkreta affärsinsikter.
En innovativ och uppskattad arbetsmiljö: Du blir en del av ett engagerat team i en dynamisk miljö där din kunskap inom datamodellering värderas högt och där du uppmuntras att driva best practices.
Rätta förutsättningar att växa: Du erbjuds en utvecklande konsultroll på heltid i Malmö med start ASAP, där du får stort eget ansvar att säkra datakvalitet och bygga broar mellan teknik och verksamhet.

Arbetsuppgifter
Rollen innebär att ansvara för datamodellering och arkitektur för att omvandla rådata till strukturerade insikter som stödjer affärsbeslut genom hela organisationen.
Förvandla komplex rådata till smarta och strukturerade datamodeller  
Utveckla och optimera centrala dataflöden med dbt som huvudverktyg  
Säkerställa att data är tillförlitlig, jämförbar och av högsta kvalitet  
Agera brygga mellan Data Engineers och verksamhetens olika analytiker  
Driva och sätta standarder för best practices inom datamodellering  
Implementera gemensamma definitioner för att säkra datans affärsvärde  
Säkerställa att kärnmodellerna möter organisationens långsiktiga behov

Vi söker dig som
Erfarenhet av rollen som Analytics Engineer, BI-utvecklare eller liknande
Avancerad kunskap i datamodellering med verktyg som dbt
Förmåga att uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska
Erfarenhet av att arbeta självständigt i en snabbrörlig miljö

Det är meriterande om du har
Gedigna kunskaper i SQL
Erfarenhet av BigQuery eller andra molnbaserade datalager
Erfarenhet av BI-verktyg som Looker, Qlik, Power BI eller Tableau

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:
Förändringsbenägen
Hjälpsam
Social
Ordningsam
Intellektuellt nyfiken

Vår rekryteringsprocess
Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

description.text:
About Hotmat.se
Hotmat.se is a growing Swedish food delivery company that partners with restaurants across Sweden. We develop and maintain our own digital platforms and are looking for a Data Analyst to help us understand our business better and make smarter, faster decisions.


Job Description
As a Data Analyst at Hotmat.se, you will be responsible for turning our order, delivery, and customer data into clear insights that support the business. You will work closely with our leadership and development team to build reporting that helps us track performance, spot problems early, and grow more efficiently.


Responsibilities
Analyze order, delivery, and customer data to identify trends and issues
Clean, structure, and prepare data from multiple sources (orders, deliveries, payments, customer feedback) to ensure quality and consistency
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using visualization tools
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract data from our databases
Use Python and pandas for deeper analysis on larger datasets
Present findings in a clear, actionable way to non-technical stakeholders
Collaborate with the development team on data collection and quality


Required Skills
SQL
Python and pandas
Excel
Data cleaning and preparation
Data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or similar)

Passionate about data and turning numbers into decisions
Self-motivated and proactive
Detail-oriented and quality-focused
A strong problem solver
Able to work independently as well as part of a team


What We Offer
Opportunity to shape how a growing company uses data, from the ground up
A growing and innovative company
Flexible working environment
Exciting technical challenges


Location
Gothenburg office


Employment Type
Full-time, permanent position with an initial probationary period.


How to Apply
Please send your CV and, if available, examples of past analysis or dashboards, to jobb@hotmat.se

description.text:
About the role
The Analytics Engineer designs, builds and owns Kisi's trusted, AI-ready data and insights layer. Rather than fielding individual data requests, the role makes sure that people and AI tools across the company get correct, authorized and context-aware answers on their own, and measures how accurate and impactful those answers are.
Responsibilities
Data activation in operational tools. Deliver relevant, trusted data into the tools each team already uses (e.g. enriching HubSpot with data from Stripe, Chargebee, the Kisi API and other sources) so teams can act without requesting reports.
Trusted insights layer. Build and maintain a documented, semantically modeled layer that humans and AI can query for accurate answers. Encode business context (such as the Stripe to Chargebee migration) and surface known data-quality limitations alongside results.
Consolidation of reporting assets. Migrate existing dashboards, reports and connected Sheets onto the insights layer to create a single source of truth.
Self-serve audiences and ad-hoc requests. Enable teams to build targeted audiences and one-off data pulls themselves, including through AI tools, and handle remaining business requests as they arise.
Source coverage. Integrate the business data sources needed for complete insights, such as Google Analytics, Facebook Ads and other marketing platforms.
Data governance and access control. Ensure every consumer, human or AI, can only access data they are authorized to see, with role-based access across the insights layer, dashboards and AI integrations.
Quality and impact measurement. Maintain an accuracy benchmark of known-correct figures and track adoption, time saved and decisions supported.
Success looks like: Team members get the insights they need, right when they need them, and trust them.

Qualifications
Strong SQL and data modeling skills, including dimensional or semantic modeling in a cloud warehouse (BigQuery or similar)
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and integrations with SaaS tools such as HubSpot, Stripe and Chargebee
Experience making data usable by AI tools and LLMs, including documentation, semantic layers and guardrails
Working knowledge of data governance and role-based access control
Ability to translate business questions into durable data products and to explain data limitations clearly to non-technical stakeholders

description.text:
Bygg skalbara och säkra molnlösningar i en senior roll där Java, AWS, Kubernetes och DevOps står i centrum.
Vill du bygga robusta, skalbara och säkra molnlösningar i en tekniskt bred senior roll? Här får du kombinera Javautveckling, AWS-arkitektur och Kubernetes med fokus på moderna, molnnativa plattformar.
Om rollen
Driv utvecklingen av molnbaserade lösningar med hög tillgänglighet och säkerhet.
Kombinera lösningsarkitektur med praktisk utveckling och tekniskt ledarskap.
Arbeta i en agil miljö tillsammans med utvecklings- och DevOps-team.

Det här kommer du göra
Designa och vidareutveckla molnarkitektur och tekniska vägval i AWS.
Utveckla högpresterande Java-applikationer, REST-API:er och mikrotjänster.
Driftsätta och förvalta containeriserade applikationer i Amazon EKS.
Bygga och förbättra CI/CD-flöden samt automatisera infrastruktur.
Införa övervakning, loggning och säkerhetsrutiner för molnplattformen.

Vi söker dig som har
Senior erfarenhet av Javautveckling och molnnativa lösningar.
Gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av AWS och Kubernetes i produktionsmiljö.
Erfarenhet av mikrotjänstarkitektur, containerisering och API-utveckling.
Kunskap om molnsäkerhet, nätverk, IAM, VPC och säkerhetsgrupper.
Förmåga att felsöka komplexa tekniska problem och samarbeta nära andra team.

Teknik & Verktyg
AWS, Amazon EKS, AWS Lambda, Amazon ECS och Elastic Beanstalk.
Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate och REST-API:er.
Kubernetes, Docker och mikrotjänster.
Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Jenkins och AWS CodePipeline.
Prometheus, Grafana, Amazon CloudWatch och AWS OpenSearch.

Praktisk information
Ort: Göteborg.
Arbetssätt: Arbete på plats.
Språk: Engelska.

31491533.headline: International Trainee - Hydro Power Optimisation and Data Analytics

description.text:
Company Description
Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes, and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.
Job Description
Shape the future of energy
Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives, and contribute to solving one of society’s most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall, and contribute to the energy transition from day one.
About the traineeship
This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each trainee position is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area, and working location. Each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges, and matching profile.
What you will experience
Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges
Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall’s different markets, business areas and locations through program activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration
Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives, and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm explains “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”
Your role as a Trainee Hydro Power Optimisation and Data Analytics Engineer
As a Hydro Power Optimisation and Data Analytics Engineer Trainee, you will join Production Support, a specialist and development function that supports safe, efficient and flexible hydropower production through optimisation, data analysis, digital tools and common working methods.
You will work closely with optimisation and development engineers, as well as colleagues in Production, Control Centres, Asset Management, IT and Markets. Together, you will turn operational and market-related needs into analyses, decision support and practical improvements for the operation of our generating units.
The role combines analytical problem-solving with hands-on development. You will use production and measurement data to evaluate performance, identify deviations and improvement opportunities, and contribute to the development of optimisation models, system services, forecasts, visualisations and data-driven working methods.
This is an opportunity to build broad expertise at the intersection of hydropower operations, energy markets, engineering and digitalisation, while contributing to increased flexibility, availability and long-term value from our hydropower assets.
Examples of your tasks and responsibilities:
Analyse production, operational and market-related data to identify trends, deviations and opportunities for improved performance
Support optimisation of generating units, water use and ancillary services through calculations, simulations and structured evaluation
Develop and improve analytical models, dashboards, visualisations and decision-support tools
Contribute to production analyses and technical studies for plant upgrades, operational changes and investment decisions
Work with data quality, measurement data and requirements for reliable and reusable data products.

Qualifications
Requirements for this trainee position
A Master of Science in Engineering or equivalent degree in a relevant field, such as Energy Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science or Data Science
Knowledge of data analysis, statistics, optimisation, modelling or simulation
Experience from programming or analytical tools, for example Python
Be fluent in Swedish and English; proficiency in additional languages is considered a merit.

You also recognize yourself in
You approach complex questions in a structured and analytical way, and can turn data into clear conclusions
You have an interest in optimisation, digital solutions, and how they create operational and business value
You are curious, proactive, and motivated to test new methods while maintaining quality and reliability
You enjoy collaborating across professional boundaries, and can communicate technical findings to different audiences
You take responsibility, share knowledge, and are motivated by creating practical improvements for the business
You are motivated to combine engineering knowledge, data and collaboration to improve hydropower production.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.
As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”
To be considered for Vattenfall’s trainee programme, you should:
Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the program starts in March 2027
Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
Be available for the full-time program from its start date 
Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
Be open to mobility opportunities, and collaboration across different locations 
Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive, and Safe.

Additional Information
Location
This position is located in Luleå, Sweden. You will work within Production Support in Business Unit Hydro Nordics.
Our offer 
“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve."

description.text:
Analytics Engineer
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time 
The Role:
As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.
As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.


Who you are:
A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions.
Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more.
Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly.
A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar.



Qualifications 
We are looking for someone with:
A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions).
Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines.
Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work.
Fluency in written and spoken English (business level).
Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design.



Nice to have:
Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on.



What you will do:
You will join the cross-functional data team responsible for Netlight's data platform, enabling decentralized analytics across the organisation. Your key focus areas will be:
Data Modeling & Quality: Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics, business intelligence, and AI use cases. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics. Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools, and build robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.
Governance & Enablement: Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants). Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need. Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership).
Optimization & Agile Delivery: Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability. Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles. Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what is genuinely useful.



What we offer:
The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
Mental health & parental support offerings
30 days of paid vacation.



Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
Private pension savings

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
Deutschlandticket
Wellpass



About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.


Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.


Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or any repositories are welcome. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what is genuinely useful.


What we offer:

  • The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
  • Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
  • Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
  • A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
  • Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
  • Mental health & parental support offerings
  • 30 days of paid vacation.


Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:

  • 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
  • Private pension savings

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:

  • Deutschlandticket
  • Wellpass


About us

Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.


Come work with us

You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.


Apply today

This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.

Send us your current CV in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or any repositories are welcome. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

Are you passionate about turning AI capabilities into real business value?

We are looking for an AI Solutions Engineer who can bridge the gap between business and technology. You'll help identify opportunities, design AI and automation solutions, build prototypes, and guide stakeholders through the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both technology and people: strong enough technically to design solutions, but equally comfortable explaining complex concepts in a simple and structured way.

In this role you have the opportunity to:

  • Identify AI and automation opportunities across business areas;

  • Facilitate discovery workshops and solution discussions;

  • Design and prototype AI-driven solutions;

  • Support implementation together with developers and architects;

  • Promote adoption of AI technologies and best practices;

  • Coach stakeholders and teams on AI capabilities and use cases.

What is needed in this role:

  • Experience with AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives;

  • Knowledge of technologies such as Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Power Platform, RPA, APIs, or intelligent document processing;

  • Ability to translate business problems into technology solutions;

  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills;

With us, you can experience:

description.text:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
The Role
 As Etraveli Group rapidly expands its agentic AI ecosystem, we are looking for a hands-on engineer to serve as the core technical muscle for our AI Optimization team. In this role, you will rapidly build, test, and evaluate agentic MVPs using Python, APIs, and LLM frameworks. You will design rigorous evaluation pipelines to prove accuracy, latency, and ROI, ensuring all agents align with company principles. Once validated, you will act as the key technical stakeholder translating prototypes into clean specifications for our core Technology team to scale.
Responsibilities
 Rapid Prototyping & MVP Engineering
Build functional end-to-end agents using Python, LLM frameworks, APIs, and databases.
Spin up infrastructure (vector/relational databases, docker containers) for real-world testing.
Select architectural patterns (API wrappers, lightweight RAG, function calling).
Iterate based on business feedback and discard when concepts prove unviable.



Data Rigor & Technical Evaluation
Design evaluation pipelines to benchmark accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost.
Build ground-truth labeled evaluation sets with business owners to validate production readiness.
Analyze discrepancies between agent outputs and human decisions during pilots.
Support business stakeholders in taking responsibility for prompts and business logic.
Continuously test new AI models and tools against internal benchmarks.



Feasibility & Technical Discovery
Assess operational workflows with strategy teams to determine agentic feasibility and scope difficulty.
Evaluate new agent architectures and AI tooling to recommend core platform adoption.



Handoff & Platform Stakeholder
Serve as the primary technical stakeholder to the core technology AI platform team.
Translate validated MVPs into clear technical specs, architecture diagrams, and data flows.
Partner with AI platform team to ensure seamless absorption of MVP logic into internal SDKs.



Requirements
Must Have
3+ years software engineering experience with strong Python and rapid prototyping skills.
Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration (tool use, RAG, structured outputs via LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or APIs).
Proficiency in API design, SQL, and relational/vector databases.
Experience using evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith) to benchmark performance.
Agile, pragmatic mindset for fast experimentation outside traditional sprint cycles.
Ability to convert complex business logic into concise specs for engineering teams.



Nice to Have
Background as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar fast-delivery role.
Familiarity with modern deployment stacks (FastAPI, Docker, serverless).
Domain experience in travel tech, airline distribution, or payments.
Basic product management understanding (ROI tracking, KPIs, user validation).



Benefits
The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company. With us you can enjoy:
A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you will have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location.
Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.
Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

description.text:
Vill du vara med och forma nästa generations data- och AI-förmåga i ett av Sveriges mest välkända familjeföretag? Hos Spendrups byggs en modern dataplattform från grunden och tar klivet direkt in i framtidens tillämpade AI.
Om tjänsten
Spendrups är ett stolt familjeföretag i fjärde generationen där traditon möter ständig innovation. Med cirka 1 100 medarbetare på bryggerier i Grängesberg, Hällefors och Visby, samt kontor och terminaler runt om i Sverige, är de en av landets ledande dryckesproducenter.
Spendrups AI-landskap är just nu under uppbyggnad, vilket ger dig en unik möjlighet att vara med från ett tidigt skede och påverka arkitektur, tekniska vägval, arbetssätt och hur de omsätter AI till konkret verksamhetsnytta för allt från logistik och sälj till produktion.  
Som Senior Data & AI Engineer får du en nyckelroll i att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till robusta, säkra och skalbara lösningar. Du blir en del av ett mindre, tvärfunktionellt team med stort mandat att driva utvecklingen framåt. Hos Spendrups arbetar du genom hela livscykeln: ena dagen utvecklar du en datapipeline eller datamodell i Microsoft Fabric och dbt, nästa dag bygger du en AI-agent, en MCP-lösning eller en integration som låter en språkmodell använda verksamhetsdata på ett kontrollerat sätt.
Spendrups arbetar iterativt och produktnära: identifierar rätt problem, testar hypoteser snabbt och realiserar det som ger effekt. Du kombinerar hands-on utveckling med tekniskt ledarskap och hjälper Spendrups etablera moderna arbetssätt för AI engineering - med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet, kostnadsuppföljning och faktisk nytta. 
Arbetsuppgifter
Dataplattform & Pipelines: Designa och utveckla datapipelines, datamodeller och plattformskapabiliteter i Microsoft Fabric och dbt.  
Tillämpad AI i produktion: Utveckla och produktionssätta AI-lösningar, såsom AI-agenter, RAG-arkitekturer, semantisk sökning och intelligenta arbetsflöden.  
System- & Modellintegration: Integrera språkmodeller med verksamhetsdata, API:er och verktyg i Azure och Microsoft Foundry.  
Kvalitetssäkring & Evals: Etablera tester och utvärderingar (evals, observability, guardrails) som mäter kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och kostnad i våra lösningar.  
Verksamhetsnära utveckling: Arbeta nära verksamheten för att identifiera use-cases, bygga prototyper och omsätta dem till skalbara lösningar.  
Tekniskt ledarskap: Bidra till teknisk riktning, kodgranskning, CI/CD, dokumentation och gemensamma engineering-principer.

Vi söker dig som har
Flera års erfarenhet inom Data Engineering, samt att du under senare tid arbetat med eller skiftat fokus mot AI Engineering.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL med erfarenhet av att skriva testbar, produktionsredo kod.
Erfarenhet av Azure (eller liknande molnmiljöer), moderna dataplattformar, ETL/ELT-flöden samt datamodellering.
Praktisk förståelse för generativ AI och språkmodeller (exempelvis RAG, embeddings, vektorsökning eller AI-agenter).
Erfarenhet av API-integrationer, Git, CI/CD och automatisering.
Förmåga att bedöma tekniska lösningar utifrån skalbarhet, säkerhet och mätbar verksamhetsnytta.

Det är meriterande om du har:
Erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry eller Azure AI-tjänster.
Hands-on erfarenhet av dbt för strukturerad datamodellering.
Kunskap om agentiska arbetsflöden, prompt/context engineering, guardrails och utvärderingsramverk (evals).
Erfarenhet av vektordatabaser och arbete med ostrukturerad data.
Erfarenhet av MLOps/LLMOps, data governance och Power BI.

 
Personliga egenskaper
Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett starkt engineering-mindset med nyfikenhet på hur AI kan förändra arbetssätt och beslut. Du tycker om att gå från ett otydligt verksamhetsproblem till en fungerande lösning, men förstår också att verkligt värde uppstår först när lösningen är säker, mätbar, förvaltbar och används i vardagen. Du tar initiativ, experimenterar pragmatiskt och delar öppet med dig av lärdomar. Samtidigt är du trygg i att välja bort teknik som inte löser rätt problem och i att balansera innovation med kvalitet, ansvar och långsiktighet.
Vår rekryteringsprocess
Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

description.text:
Do you want to build computer-vision technology that helps autonomous drones understand and navigate the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, edge computing, software, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in developing and improving the perception capabilities behind our drone platform.You will work on challenging real-world problems where robust vision, accurate localisation and reliable performance matter. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys going beyond algorithms and prototypes to build computer-vision solutions that perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.

The role:
You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do:
- Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto's drone and autonomy platform.
- Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
- Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
- Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
- Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
- Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
- Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
- Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
- Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
- Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
- Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
- You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
- You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
- Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
- You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
- You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
- You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for:
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.
- Strong practical knowledge of computer vision, with experience in areas such as object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM or related perception methods.
- Strong C++ programming skills, with Python experience for algorithm development, experimentation, testing and prototyping.
- Experience taking computer-vision or machine-learning solutions beyond research and prototyping into real products or deployed systems.
- Experience designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for computer-vision applications.
- Experience deploying and optimising models or computer-vision algorithms on edge or resource-constrained computing platforms is highly relevant.
- Strong understanding of algorithm evaluation, datasets, testing methodologies and measurable performance criteria.
- Experience contributing to architecture or technical-design decisions within complex software or perception systems.
- A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
- Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are:
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
- You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
- You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
- You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
- You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
- You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
- You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

More information and application:
https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8259919-senior-computer-vision-ai-engineer

You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do:
- Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto's drone and autonomy platform.
- Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
- Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
- Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
- Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
- Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
- Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
- Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
- Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
- Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
- Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
- You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
- You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
- Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
- You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
- You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
- You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for:
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.
- Strong practical knowledge of computer vision, with experience in areas such as object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM or related perception methods.
- Strong C++ programming skills, with Python experience for algorithm development, experimentation, testing and prototyping.
- Experience taking computer-vision or machine-learning solutions beyond research and prototyping into real products or deployed systems.
- Experience designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for computer-vision applications.
- Experience deploying and optimising models or computer-vision algorithms on edge or resource-constrained computing platforms is highly relevant.
- Strong understanding of algorithm evaluation, datasets, testing methodologies and measurable performance criteria.
- Experience contributing to architecture or technical-design decisions within complex software or perception systems.
- A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
- Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are:
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
- You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
- You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
- You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
- You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
- You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
- You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

More information and application:
https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8259919-senior-computer-vision-ai-engineer

description.text:
Looking for a workplace for the future?
At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future. 
We are now looking for Strategic AI Developer / Google Cloud AI Engineer to join our AI & Automation team. 
How you’ll make a difference with us
As part of Telenor's Center of AI Acceleration, within Data & Analytics, you will help shape the future of AI across the company by designing, developing, and scaling innovative AI solutions that solve complex business challenges. As more of our data, analytics, and AI capabilities move to Google Cloud, you will play a key role in establishing and growing our expertise in Google's AI ecosystem, including Gemini, Vertex AI, and agent-based solutions.
In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, data professionals, architects, and developers to identify opportunities where AI can create real business value. You will design and build solutions ranging from generative AI assistants and intelligent automation to advanced multi-agent systems that support business processes across multiple functions. Key responsibilities include:

Designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions using Google Cloud technologies such as Vertex AI, Gemini, and related services.


Building generative AI and agent-based applications that improve customer experiences, employee productivity, and operational efficiency.


Developing and orchestrating multi-agent solutions that automate complex business processes spanning multiple teams and systems.


Collaborating with business units to transform ideas and use cases into scalable production-ready AI solutions.


Contributing to AI architecture, development standards, best practices, and platform evolution.


Sharing knowledge and helping grow Google AI capabilities


By helping Telenor harness the power of AI, you will contribute to delivering smarter services, faster problem resolution, and more personalized customer experiences, ultimately helping make our customers' lives safer, simpler, and more worry-free.
Are you the one we’re looking for?
We're looking for a curious and hands-on AI developer who is excited by emerging technologies and passionate about applying AI to solve real business problems.
Must-have qualifications

Experience developing AI, ML, generative AI, or intelligent automation solutions.


Experience with modern software development practices.


Experience with cloud-native development on public cloud (Google Cloud preferred).


Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, or related AI technologies.


Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


A proactive mindset with a strong desire to learn and adapt to emerging technologies.


Preferred experience

Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vertex AI, Gemini, or related Google AI services.


Experience building agentic or multi-agent AI solutions.


Experience deploying AI solutions into production environments.


Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI, or other enterprise AI platforms.


Experience working in agile product teams and cross-functional environments.


Bachelor's in computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field, or other relevant certifications and/or training that demonstrates learned knowledge.

Our promise to you!
We are better together. Here, you’ll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other’s backs through ups and downs.
We support relationships and societies.Telenor plays a vital role in the society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.
We make room for life. Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. You also get two ‘give-me-a-break’ days per year for extra time off, and our flexible working hours help you balance your time. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.
We invite you to a career in motion. Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year for you to deepen your expertise, explore new areas, and develop in your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you’ll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics. 
Apply today! Will you take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to your application! We review applicants on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait—reach out today.
If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager Kevin Libbos at kevin.libbos@telenor.se. Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.
Good to know As part of Telenor’s policy, we conduct background checks on final candidates for all recruitments.

description.text:
Arbetsbeskrivning
Som Senior AI Engineer får du en nyckelroll i utvecklingen av vår strategiska AI-plattform. Du kombinerar hands-on programmering med ansvar för arkitektur, tekniska vägval och genomförande av AI-initiativ. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med utvecklare, Data Scientists och produktledare för att omsätta affärsbehov till skalbara lösningar som skapar konkret nytta.
Tjänsten tillhör IT-organisationen, rapporterar till Head of Architecture & Integration och erbjuder ett flexibelt hybridupplägg från något av våra kontor i Sverige.



Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, pragmatisk och tekniskt driven. Du är en problemlösare som trivs i samarbetet mellan teknik och verksamhet och motiveras av att bygga lösningar som skapar riktigt värde.

Ansvarsområden
Utveckla, driftsätta och underhålla AI-lösningar med fokus på Python, backend och API-integrationer.
Bygga lösningar inom generativ AI, såsom AI-agenter, RAG-arkitekturer och LLM-applikationer.
Bidra till arkitektur, säkerhet och den långsiktiga utvecklingen av koncernens AI-plattform.
Omvärldsbevaka AI-området och driva kontinuerliga förbättringsinitiativ.

Kvalifikationer
Minst ~5 års erfarenhet av AI-utveckling samt goda kunskaper i Python.
Erfarenhet av att driftsätta AI-lösningar i produktionsmiljö (LLM, RAG, embeddings, AI-agenter).
Erfarenhet av API-utveckling, integrationer, Git och CI/CD.
Förmåga att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar.
Flytande i svenska och engelska.

Meriterande: Erfarenhet av Azure AI Services/OpenAI, Databricks, Kubernetes, Terraform, LangChain eller LangGraph.

Om företaget

Randstad
På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential. 
Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

description.text:
Vi söker en AI Engineer som vill bygga lösningar som faktiskt används i verksamheten. För dig är AI inte en demo vid sidan av, utan ett verktyg för att lösa riktiga problem, automatisera arbete och skapa bättre sätt att jobba.

Du gillar att bygga, testa och få saker i produktion. Hos oss arbetar du nära både kunden och tekniken och behöver därför vara lika nyfiken på problemet som på modellen, arkitekturen eller verktyget som kan lösa det.

Vad du kommer att göra

Du kommer bland annat att:

designa, bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar med generativ AI, LLM:er, agents och automation
koppla AI till affärssystem, dataplattformar, API:er och andra verksamhetskritiska system
välja rätt angreppssätt för exempelvis retrieval, tool use och agentbaserade flöden
ta lösningar från idé och proof of concept till robust implementation och produktion
arbeta med utvärdering, testning, säkerhet, behörigheter och spårbarhet
samarbeta nära kunder för att förstå processer, data och behov och omsätta dem till fungerande lösningar


Vem vi tror att du är

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet inom systemutveckling, data, AI eller liknande och har byggt moderna AI-lösningar i praktiken.

Du behöver inte komma från klassisk machine learning eller forskning. Det viktiga är att du kan bygga fungerande produkter, integrationer och automationer och förstår vad som krävs för att få dem att fungera utanför en demo.

Vi tror också att du:

är en stark utvecklare och känner dig hemma i exempelvis Python, TypeScript, C# eller liknande
har erfarenhet av LLM-baserade lösningar och hur de kopplas till data, verktyg och externa system
är van vid API:er, integrationer och moderna moln- och utvecklingsmiljöer
förstår hur AI kan kopplas till ERP-miljöer som SAP, datalager och andra affärssystem
kan resonera kring säkerhet, behörigheter och dataskydd
är pragmatisk, självgående och bekväm med att välja teknik utifrån problemet snarare än leverantören
kan prata med både verksamheten och tekniska team
kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av AI-agenter, moderna integrationsmönster för AI eller plattformar och modeller från exempelvis OpenAI, Anthropic eller Microsoft.

Du behöver inte kunna allt. Det viktiga är att du har en stabil teknisk grund, är nyfiken och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Varför Norrminds?

Du börjar inte på Norrminds bara för att få ett nytt jobb.

Vi bygger ett bolag där människor med olika styrkor får stort ansvar, kan påverka hur vi arbetar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vi tror på modet att testa gränser, på att göra saker tillsammans och på att teknik ska skapa nytta, inte bara mer teknik.

Vi arbetar i gränslandet mellan AI, affärssystem, integration och automation. Här får du arbeta nära de processer och system där AI faktiskt kan göra skillnad och samtidigt vara med och forma hur vi bygger vårt AI-erbjudande framåt.

Rollen kan utgå från Malmö, Linköping eller Stockholm. I dessa städer vill vi bygga något långsiktigt, så du ska tycka om tanken på att vara nära både kunder och framtida kollegor och vara med och forma Norrminds lokalt.

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

description.text:
TL;DR
We're looking for a founding AI Engineer to help build the AI colleague every sales professional wishes they had. You'll own the agent stack end-to-end - from model selection to database (knowledge graph) structure and search algorithm development. Must be curious, experimental, and obsessed with agentic systems.
Why join
We’re a small, talent-dense team of engineers building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value speed, rigour, and extreme ownership. If you're obsessed with product, thrive in ambiguity, and want to push the edge of what agents can do, you’ll feel at home.
You’ll work on pushing the cutting edge in the agentic stack - including LLM fine-tuning, knowledge graphs, memory, orchestration, and intelligent retrieval. Not another chatbot.
We're backed by founders and operators behind Lovable, OpenAI, Tandem Health, and Neo4j. Our customers across 10 countries report 90% less prospecting time, 3x market coverage, and 2x customer meetings.
What you'll do (responsibilities)
In one sentence: Build the next generation agentic system.
Design and build agentic workflows powered by LLMs, vector search, and knowledge graphs
Build autonomous background agents that run real revenue workflows — triggered by schedules and CRM events, working across email, CRM, and the web
Own the agent stack end-to-end: from infrastructure to product logic
Ship fast: test ideas, run experiments, iterate daily
Shape the product, the stack, and the culture from the ground up

Who you are
Cracked engineer obsessed with building great software
Comfortable with ambiguity, early-stage chaos, and fast iteration
Thrive on new tech - LLMs, knowledge graphs, agents, you name it
Care more about solving problems than polishing abstractions
Fully committed to the mission: not "just a job"

What we offer
A team of obsessed engineers, full of speed, rigour, and grit
Mission-driven, no-BS culture: experiment, ship, learn
Meaningful equity through qualified employee stock options (QESO) from day one
Fully on-site in Stockholm - we believe in working together
Top-tier compensation package

Our stack
Frontend: React
Backend: Typescript, Node.js, Express, Neo4j, PostgreSQL
Agent: Typescript, LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), Mastra

About Spiich Labs
Spiich is the agentic platform for sales teams. Reps focus on the human work — building relationships, building trust, and closing deals — while Spiich agents handle everything else: prospecting, lead generation, CRM updates, meeting prep, follow-ups, and everything in between. The system integrates knowledge graphs, memory, and agentic workflows to deliver real help - not just summarisation or search. We're backed by founders and operators behind Lovable, OpenAI, Tandem Health, and Neo4j.
How we hire
Submit your application
Intro call with the team
Technical interview
Take-home exercise
Join us for trial work lasting 2 days on-site. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Spiich feels right for you.

TL;DR

We're looking for a founding AI Engineer to help build the AI colleague every sales professional wishes they had. You'll own the agent stack end-to-end - from model selection to database (knowledge graph) structure and search algorithm development. Must be curious, experimental, and obsessed with agentic systems.

Why join

We’re a small, talent-dense team of engineers building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value speed, rigour, and extreme ownership. If you're obsessed with product, thrive in ambiguity, and want to push the edge of what agents can do, you’ll feel at home.

You’ll work on pushing the cutting edge in the agentic stack - including LLM fine-tuning, knowledge graphs, memory, orchestration, and intelligent retrieval. Not another chatbot.

We're backed by founders and operators behind Lovable, OpenAI, Tandem Health, and Neo4j. Our customers across 10 countries report 90% less prospecting time, 3x market coverage, and 2x customer meetings.

What you'll do (responsibilities)

In one sentence: Build the next generation agentic system.

  • Design and build agentic workflows powered by LLMs, vector search, and knowledge graphs
  • Build autonomous background agents that run real revenue workflows — triggered by schedules and CRM events, working across email, CRM, and the web
  • Own the agent stack end-to-end: from infrastructure to product logic
  • Ship fast: test ideas, run experiments, iterate daily
  • Shape the product, the stack, and the culture from the ground up

Who you are

  • Cracked engineer obsessed with building great software
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, early-stage chaos, and fast iteration
  • Thrive on new tech - LLMs, knowledge graphs, agents, you name it
  • Care more about solving problems than polishing abstractions
  • Fully committed to the mission: not "just a job"

What we offer

  • A team of obsessed engineers, full of speed, rigour, and grit
  • Mission-driven, no-BS culture: experiment, ship, learn
  • Meaningful equity through qualified employee stock options (QESO) from day one
  • Fully on-site in Stockholm - we believe in working together
  • Top-tier compensation package

Our stack

  • Frontend: React
  • Backend: Typescript, Node.js, Express, Neo4j, PostgreSQL
  • Agent: Typescript, LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), Mastra

About Spiich Labs

Spiich is the agentic platform for sales teams. Reps focus on the human work — building relationships, building trust, and closing deals — while Spiich agents handle everything else: prospecting, lead generation, CRM updates, meeting prep, follow-ups, and everything in between. description.text:
Vi söker en Project Manager som vill leda förändring där verksamhet, affärssystem och ny teknik möts. För dig handlar projektledning inte bara om planer och deadlines, utan om att förstå vad som behöver förändras och få människor, teknik och beslut att dra åt samma håll.

Du gillar att skapa struktur i komplexa sammanhang och röra dig mellan verksamheten och tekniska team. Hos oss kan projekten handla om AI, ERP och affärssystem, integrationer, automation eller andra digitala förändringar.

Vad du kommer att göra

Du kommer bland annat att:

leda projekt från förstudie och behovsanalys till implementation och uppföljning
skapa struktur kring mål, scope, plan, budget, risker, beroenden och beslut
leda workshops och hjälpa verksamheten att konkretisera behov och målbild
översätta mellan verksamhet, IT, utvecklingsteam, leverantörer och andra intressenter
arbeta nära tekniska team och förstå hur system, data, processer och integrationer påverkar leveransen
koordinera test, införande, förändring och övergång till förvaltning när det behövs
skapa tydliga beslutsunderlag och kommunicera framdrift, risker och vägval
utmana krav och arbetssätt när det finns ett bättre sätt att nå målet


Vem vi tror att du är

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet av projektledning, verksamhetsutveckling eller digital transformation och har lett initiativ där verksamhet och IT behöver fungera tillsammans.

Du behöver inte vara SAP-konsult, utvecklare eller AI Engineer. Däremot är du tekniskt nyfiken, kan snabbt sätta dig in i nya systemmiljöer och är bekväm med att arbeta nära både verksamheten och de som bygger lösningen.

Vi tror också att du:

har drivit IT-, system- eller transformationsprojekt från behov till genomförande
är van vid krav, processer, workshops och intressenthantering
förstår grunderna i affärssystem, integrationer och data
kan växla mellan helhet och detaljer och själv ta tag i analys eller krav när det behövs
förstår att införande av ny teknik också handlar om människor, arbetssätt och förändring
har börjat använda AI som ett naturligt verktyg i ditt eget arbete
är tydlig, prestigelös och trygg i dialog med både projektteam och beslutsfattare
driver saker framåt utan att behöva bli detaljstyrd
kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ERP- eller affärssystemsprojekt, SAP, AI-initiativ, automation, integrationer, systemimplementationer eller större förändringsprogram.

Det viktiga är inte vilken projektmodell du föredrar eller hur många certifieringar du har. Vi lägger större vikt vid att du kan förstå problemet, skapa förtroende och driva en komplex leverans hela vägen fram.

Varför Norrminds?

Du börjar inte på Norrminds bara för att få ett nytt jobb.

Vi bygger ett bolag där människor med olika styrkor får stort ansvar, kan påverka hur vi arbetar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vi tror på modet att testa gränser, på att göra saker tillsammans och på att teknik ska skapa nytta, inte bara mer teknik.

Vi arbetar i gränslandet mellan AI, affärssystem, integration och automation. Som Project Manager får du arbeta nära både tekniken och verksamheten och vara med där idéer blir till lösningar och nya arbetssätt.

Rollen kan utgå från Malmö, Linköping eller Stockholm. I dessa städer vill vi bygga något långsiktigt, så du ska tycka om tanken på att vara nära både kunder och framtida kollegor och vara med och forma Norrminds lokalt.

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

description.text:
The role
You’ll work within the AI team reporting to the AI & Innovation Lead. You will be primarily supporting R&D and Solutions but collaborating with all teams, to embed AI into Prover’s engineering workflows and help shape our next generation of AI-powered products, initially for railway signaling, and over time for safety-critical systems more broadly.
You will:
Build AI agents and assistants that accelerate formal verification and engineering workflows
Evaluate and integrate agent SDKs (e.g., Anthropic Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar) to build our own internal AI platform
Prototype AI-powered features for Prover Station, our digital twin and formal verification platform
Explore how LLMs can accelerate the adoption of formal methods in safety-critical domains

What we’re looking for
A hands-on builder who has shipped tools or prototypes using LLMs or AI agents, professionally, inside projects, or in open source
Deeply curious about AI and the fast-moving landscape of agent frameworks and developer tooling
Comfortable across the stack. We care more about builder mindset than a specific language or framework
Strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with domain experts in formal methods and signaling
Motivated by impact. Rail is one of the most energy-efficient modes of transport, and that matters to you

Nice to have:
Experience with agent SDKs and platforms
Familiarity with formal methods such as formal logic, formal specification, model checking, proof-oriented programming, and theorem proving
Experience building internal developer tools or platforms
Interest in domain-specific languages and how AI can make them more accessible
